name: Warp-Crowned Focus
summary: When you trigger Perils, you may choose to gain 1 Corruption to reduce the severity roll by 1d6 after seeing the result. Malefic-Touched Psykers cannot use this to reduce Catastrophic Perils below Reality Tear.
